paper_title: Constraints on axion-like dark matter from a SERF comagnetometer
notes: Paper constrains both ALP-neutron (gaNN) and ALP-proton (gaPP) couplings using a SERF comagnetometer with 3He (neutron) and 39K (proton). The primary novel result is the first terrestrial ALP-proton bound, hence AxionProton selected per hint and emphasis. Mass range 1.4e-12 to 2e-10 eV. Data points are approximate readings from Fig.2 (right panel, gaPP) since precise values are only in external GitHub repository [57]; no in-paper table. Couplings expressed in GeV^-1 as in figure. DM density (standard halo model) assumed but specific GeV/cm^3 value not stated in text. Neutron coupling data also available (similar range, ~1e-5 to 1e-4 GeV^-1) but only one coupling type can be reported.
